WITH album_rates AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS album_rate
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
overall_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(album_rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM album_rates
)
SELECT
  ar.AlbumId,
  ar.avg_unit_price,
  ar.album_rate,
  ar.album_rate - o.avg_rate AS rate_above_average
FROM album_rates ar
CROSS JOIN overall_rate o
WHERE ar.album_rate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY rate_above_average DESC
LIMIT 10
